Add deployment coordinates to observations

Source: R/add_coordinates.R
add_coordinates.Rd

This function adds deployment coordinates to observations based on deploymentID.

Usage

add_coordinates(x)

Arguments

x

Camera trap data package object, as returned by camtrapdp::read_camtrapdp().

Value

Camera trap data package object, where observations is updated by appending two new columns: latitude and longitude

Details

When the latitude and/or the longitude columns are already present in observations, a warning is issued and the original object is returned unchanged.

Examples

x <- example_dataset()

# Add coordinates to observations
add_coordinates(x) %>% observations()
